facts.fact: The Council of Ministers communiqué of 21 December 2022 states that a data centre built by the state's digital infrastructure company (SIN) in Lomé is operating and offers storage services to economic operators, and authorises its transfer to a private operator not yet named; the document gives no opening date, so the date is that of the council meeting.

systems.owner: Société d'infrastructures numériques (SIN), state; transfer to a private operator authorised 2022-12-21
